message: Property "title" sets `encoding.title.contentType`, but the request body is `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, not multipart. Per-property `contentType` is only meaningful for multipart request bodies (OAS 3.x §4.8.24.1).

Property "q" sets `encoding.q.contentType`, but the request body is `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`, not multipart. Per-property `contentType` is only meaningful for multipart request bodies (OAS 3.x §4.8.24.1).
